This is the extdata/germline_sequences/AIRR/human/ folder in the igblastr
package.

This folder contains germline sequences (in FASTA format) downloaded from
AIRR-community/OGRDB for human.

- 202309/: See README.md in 202309/ subfolder.

- 202410/: See README.md in 202410/ subfolder.
